backend/main.mo: Motoko canister implementing access control, user profile storage, and blob/file reference registration with admin-protected operations.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing features, affected frontend files, components, and test IDs for styling and layout updates.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains prewritten summaries of many frontend components, pages, hooks, and admin utilities.
frontend/.gitignore: Git ignore rules for dependencies, builds, environment files, IDE folders, OS junk, logs, and temp files.
frontend/deploy-logs/.gitkeep: Empty placeholder file ensuring the deploy‑logs directory is committed.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML file mounting the React app via a root div and loading main.tsx.
frontend/scripts/deploy.ts: Deployment script running backend binding generation, frontend build, and canister deployment with retry logic and failure logging.
frontend/scripts/deploySteps.ts: Utility for executing deploy steps with subprocess handling, stdout/stderr capture, success detection, and transient failure checks.
frontend/scripts/README.md: Brief README describing deployment scripts and build/deploy workflow.
frontend/scripts/redaction.ts: Functions to redact sensitive data such as keys, tokens, PEM blocks, principals, emails, and credentialed URLs from logs.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app handling routing, authentication, profile setup flow, and rendering all pages within a language provider.
frontend/src/components/BlogPostModal.ts: Modal for creating and editing blog posts with image upload, timestamp conversion, and form handling.
frontend/src/components/BlogSection.tsx: Displays blog posts and Instagram feed with video autoplay, view counts, and admin controls.
frontend/src/components/BlogViewModal.ts: Read-only modal showing full blog post details, formatted content, metadata, and view count.
frontend/src/components/ContactSection.t: Contact form section that submits user messages and displays contact info.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer with navigation links, localized text, and social media icons.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Responsive header with logo, navigation, tools dropdown, language selector, and authentication state handling. Periodically refetches the logo and manages hash‑based navigation.
frontend/src/components/HeroImageUploade: Admin uploader for the hero image with validation, preview, upload handling, and auto-reset. Fetches and displays the current hero image.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Displays the hero layout across breakpoints and periodically refreshes the hero image. Admins get an inline uploader overlay.
frontend/src/components/InstagramFeedMan: Full CRUD manager for Instagram feed items with media upload, previews, validation, and toast notifications. Handles both images and videos with size/type checks.
frontend/src/components/LanguageSelector: Dropdown for switching site language with click-outside handling. Lists supported languages with flags.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Login/logout button using Internet Identity with status handling and query cache clearing. Displays translated labels based on auth state.
frontend/src/components/LogoUploader.tsx: Admin uploader for the site logo with validation, upload status, preview, and auto-hide behavior. Refetches the logo URL and supports a callback on upload.
frontend/src/components/PackingListManag: Manages editable packing categories and items with default data and UI controls for adding, editing, reordering, and deleting entries.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal for creating a user profile with validation, language selection, and saving via backend mutation.
frontend/src/components/quiz/QuizActionB: Reusable button component for quiz actions with styling variants and optional disabled state.
frontend/src/components/quiz/QuizCard.ts: Simple styled card wrapper for quiz content.
frontend/src/components/quiz/QuizOptionB: Multiple-choice option button with selected, correct, incorrect, and disabled states.
frontend/src/components/quiz/QuizPage.ts: Layout wrapper providing consistent page structure for quiz screens.
frontend/src/components/quiz/QuizProgres: Displays quiz progress as percentage and a progress bar.
frontend/src/components/quiz/QuizResultS: Styles a results section with optional background variants.
frontend/src/components/QuizManager.tsx: Provides management UI for geography and travel‑style quiz questions using mock data for editing, duplication, and settings.
frontend/src/components/ShopProductManag: Admin interface for listing, creating, editing, uploading images for, and deleting shop products using API hooks.
frontend/src/components/ShopProductModal: Modal for adding or editing a shop product with validation, image uploads, and submission to the backend.
frontend/src/components/ShopSection.tsx: Displays shop products with image browsing, admin add button, and product modal handling.
frontend/src/components/ToastContainer.t: Renders toast notifications with icons, styling, and dismiss controls via toastManager.
Shows a responsive grid of travel tools with icons and links, supporting hash navigation.
frontend/src/components/TravelToolsSecti: Empty file with no implemented content.
frontend/src/components/UserManagement.t: Admin interface to view users, change roles with confirmation, and copy user details.
frontend/src/contexts/LanguageContext.ts: Provides language state, translation function, and persistence via localStorage.
frontend/src/features/travelStyleQuiz/ge: Defines a destination database keyed by travel archetype and exports a function to return matching destinations based on primary and secondary archetypes.
frontend/src/features/travelStyleQuiz/id: Contains TypeScript interfaces for Destination objects and a DestinationsResponse shape used by quiz-related features.
frontend/src/features/travelStyleQuiz/pa: Maps travel archetypes to packing list suggestions and exports a function returning the appropriate teaser lists for given archetypes.
frontend/src/features/travelStyleQuiz/pe: Provides predefined personality profiles per travel archetype and a function to retrieve bullet points and callouts based on user selections.
frontend/src/features/travelStyleQuiz/us: React hook that memoizes and returns ideal destinations for selected archetypes along with loading state.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor using react-query, refreshing dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an authentication context using Dfinity Internet Identity, handling login, logout, state management, and identity persistence.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines various react-query hooks for admin checks, user profiles, saving profiles, and listing users using the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines global Tailwind imports, custom colors, fonts, utilities, scrollbars, animations, and hover effects.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wrapping it with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboard.tsx: Renders a multi‑tab admin interface for managing blogs, users, media, tools, and settings with extensive data fetching and modals.
frontend/src/pages/BlogDetailPage.tsx: Displays a single blog post with view counting, sharing, markdown image rendering, and loading/error states.
frontend/src/pages/BlogPage.tsx: Shows a paginated, localized blog listing with view counts and navigation controls.
frontend/src/pages/GeographyQuiz.tsx: Implements a multi‑question geography quiz with flags, capitals, story generation, and Instagram export support.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Composes the homepage with hero, blog preview, shop, and contact sections.
frontend/src/pages/PackingList.tsx: Defines a packing list page with default categorized items, selection state, custom additions, and UI interactions.
frontend/src/pages/ShopPage.tsx: Renders a product shop with search, sorting, product detail modals, and affiliate link handling.
frontend/src/pages/TrainVsFlightPrices.t: Displays mock flight vs. train comparisons including pricing, duration, and savings calculations.
frontend/src/pages/TravelStyleQuiz.tsx: Implements a travel personality quiz using archetypes, questions, and result generation with story export.
frontend/src/pages/TripRandomizer.tsx: Generates randomized trips from mock flight and hotel data, showing combined pricing and destination highlights.
frontend/src/utils/instagramStoryGenerat: Generates Instagram Story images using canvas with dynamic backgrounds, logos, and styled text for quiz results.
frontend/src/utils/toast.ts: Implements a toast manager for showing, subscribing to, and clearing timed notification messages.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind styling with custom colors, themes, animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Defines project state, feature requirements, and styling updates for quiz result section tiles.
